interface.longDescription: ServeReel builds a 7 day social media content plan for a local business from its own website. The plan tool reads the site, learns the services, deals, and location, and returns a week of reel, video, and image post ideas tailored to what the business actually sells. The examples tool shows the kinds of reels, videos, image posts, and created images ServeReel produces for industries such as restaurants, salons, real estate, fitness, and dental. The signup tool returns the ServeReel start link with a short summary of what ServeReel does. The plugin only plans and informs: it creates no accounts, posts no content, and charges nothing inside ChatGPT. Making the content (finished reels and videos with real motion, voiceover, and captions, plus image posts and created images) and posting it to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube happens on ServeReel after signup. No account or sign in is needed to use the tools; the only input is a public business website address the user chooses to share.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It returns a content plan and content examples; users who want content made and posted sign up on servereel.com.
